hook.name: RobinArrow
hook.description: ERC-20 token (ARROW, 100,000 fixed supply) that doubles as a Uniswap v4 hook for the official ARROW/WETH pool. Collects swap fees in ARROW (1% on buys, 2% on sells), distributing 80% pro-rata to all eligible holders and 20% to the current "Robin Arrow" holder — a gamified title earned by qualifying buys (≥100 ARROW net) and immediately lost on any sell.
